design_notes: Prefer 64 full cells when cheap and feasible. The 32-cell design is conditional on all six binary factors being manipulable in a common eligible stratum.
Within a fixed active set, balance only legal orders; order contrasts at equal calls, candidates and observed compute. Factorial inclusion is not a measure of order.
Where precedence or format makes cells invalid, use a constrained design with explicit admissible configurations and check rank/aliasing per stratum; never impute impossible cells.
Use separate nested subexperiments for hybrid retrieval composition, tagger labels, and early verifier placement. Preserve fixed simple rules and negative controls.
